method: Manual comparison against unchanged synthetic ground truth; not independent human annotation.
selected_revision: Prompt 5 second revision; third extractive-summary experiment rejected for completion omissions and question-as-decision false positive.
decision_summary: all seven recorded choices and all six recorded reasons, with no extra decision in the no-decision case and no question-as-decision false positive. Six of seven choices have a valid notes.md source and explicit=true; circuit-garden has an empty source and is labeled inferred. Coverage is not the same as fully grounded extraction.
assertion_summary: The calibration-completed assertion is gone, but game-alpha still describes an unpassed test as a failure and additionally invents initial successful tests. The unsupported-assertion count remains two, not zero. A third extractive-summary trial reduced invented prose but omitted four recorded completions, reintroduced a question-as-decision false positive and produced a malformed resurrection hint. That trial was rejected; its full outputs remain available. The more useful second revision is the release candidate, with these limitations disclosed.

unsupported_claims.evidence: No initial successful tests are recorded.
The rig has not passed the test; the evidence does not establish a performed failed test.

other_semantic_errors.evidence: Recorded choice and reason are preserved, but no supporting source survived; the choice is labeled inferred. Pre-sanitization output was not retained, so the cause of source loss is not established.
Empty despite the rough-cut completion being correctly preserved in completed.
A faithful audit-uncited-claims paraphrase fails the frozen citation keyword; the raw 7/8 score is retained.

limitations: These development cases informed generic prompt revisions. This is a regression comparison, not a held-out benchmark. Matching words do not prove correctness; manual review is neither exhaustive nor independent.
